## File: README.md

<div align="center">

# ledger-kit

**The accounting engine of MGPL Diagnostics.**
Account groups, ledgers and vouchers, posted by double entry, with trial balance, day book, P&L and
balance sheet. Exact to the paisa, ACID on MongoDB and PostgreSQL.

![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.1.0-E9A23B) ![checks](https://img.shields.io/badge/checks-85-14264A) ![money](https://img.shields.io/badge/money-integer%20paise-14264A)

</div>

> **0.1.0** on GitHub Packages. finance-kit already posts through it.

```bash
# .npmrc: @mgpl-diagnostics:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com (a token with read:packages)
npm install @mgpl-diagnostics/ledger-kit @mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit
```

## What it does

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Chart of accounts** | the 28 standard account groups (15 primary + 13 sub-groups) and the ledgers a lab needs on day one, seeded idempotently |
| **Vouchers** | sales, receipt, payment, journal, contra, credit / debit note, purchase, closing. Numbered per type per financial year (`SAL/2026-27/000001`), always balanced, one-sided lines in whole paise, cancelled with the number kept |
| **Lock dates** | posting or cancelling on or before an organisation or branch lock date fails, checked inside the posting transaction |
| **Automatic posting** | `ledgerPostingHook`: db-kit's invoices, payments, refunds and cancellations post their own vouchers |
| **Books** | trial balance, ledger statement with running balance, cash book, day book, profit & loss (gross and net), balance sheet, outstanding receivables with ageing, GST summary; org-wide or per branch |

It is a library: the backend calls it, storage lives in
[db-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit), and money rules such as GST and settlements live in
[finance-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit).

## Use

```ts
import { createDb } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { ledgerPostingHook, seedChartOfAccounts, postVoucher, trialBalance } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/ledger-kit";

// billing (issueInvoice, recordPayment, cancelInvoice) now posts through ledger-kit
const db = await createDb({ backend: "pg", pg: { url: process.env.DATABASE_URL! }, posting: ledgerPostingHook });
const repos = db.repos;

await seedChartOfAccounts(repos, orgId); // once per organisation

const cash = await repos.ledgers.findBySystemKey(orgId, "cash");
const capital = await repos.ledgers.findBySystemKey(orgId, "capital");
await postVoucher(repos, {
  orgId, branchId, type: "receipt", narration: "Capital introduced",
  entries: [
    { ledgerId: cash!.id, debitPaise: 1_000_000, creditPaise: 0 },
    { ledgerId: capital!.id, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 1_000_000 },
  ],
}, actorId);

const tb = await trialBalance(repos, { orgId }); // tb.totalDebitPaise === tb.totalCreditPaise
```

finance-kit supplies its own hook (`financePosting`, GST by place of supply, B2B customer ledgers) and
posts through ledger-kit's `postVoucher` / `cancelVoucher`.

## Same books as db-kit 1.1.0

ledger-kit is a port of db-kit 1.1.0's `accounting.ts` and `reports.ts` with identical behaviour: the
same function names and signatures, voucher numbers, counter keys, ledger entries, audit lines, errors
and report figures. `npm test` runs one scenario (two financial years, two branches, every voucher
type, every payment mode, IGST, round-off both ways, lock dates, rejected vouchers, every report)
through db-kit's engine and through ledger-kit's, on real MongoDB and real PostgreSQL, and requires the
two sets of books to be identical. A database posted by db-kit carries on under ledger-kit with no
migration: the next voucher takes the next number.

## API

| Area | Calls |
| --- | --- |
| Chart | `TALLY_GROUPS`, `DEFAULT_LEDGERS`, `seedChartOfAccounts` |
| Vouchers | `postVoucher`, `cancelVoucher`, `assertBalanced`, `assertPeriodOpen`, `VOUCHER_PREFIX`, `voucherCounterKey` |
| Posting | `ledgerPostingHook`, `postInvoice`, `postPayment`, `unpostInvoice`, `salesEntries`, `receiptEntries`, `MODE_LEDGER` |
| Books | `ledgerBalance`, `ledgerStatement`, `cashBook`, `trialBalance`, `profitAndLoss`, `balanceSheet`, `dayBook`, `outstandingReceivables`, `gstSummary` |

Errors: `UnbalancedVoucherError` (422, a db-kit `ValidationError`), and db-kit's `ValidationError` (400),
`NotFoundError` (404) and `PeriodLockedError` (409).

## Not Tally

ledger-kit is our own, independent software. It follows the familiar Tally-style accounting concepts.
It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or compatible with Tally Solutions or its products, and it
does not import or export Tally data.

## Licence

All rights reserved. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

## File: AGENTS.md

# AGENTS.md — @mgpl-diagnostics/ledger-kit

**Our own accounting engine** for MGPL Diagnostics: account groups, ledgers, vouchers, double-entry
posting and the books reports. The approach is Tally-like (the concepts), but it is our software. We
do **not** use or integrate with Tally software: no Tally XML, no import, no export.

> **Status:** 0.1.0, published to GitHub Packages. db-kit 1.1.0's `accounting.ts` and `reports.ts` are ported with
> identical behaviour (proved by `npm test` on MongoDB and PostgreSQL); `ledgerPostingHook` is the
> PostingHook for db-kit. finance-kit's `src/posting.ts` posts through ledger-kit (step 4 below, done).
> Next: deprecate db-kit's copy of the engine (step 5).

## Map

```
src/chart.ts       TALLY_GROUPS (28), DEFAULT_LEDGERS, seedChartOfAccounts
src/vouchers.ts    VOUCHER_PREFIX, voucherCounterKey, assertBalanced, UnbalancedVoucherError,
                   assertPeriodOpen (lock dates), postVoucher, cancelVoucher
src/posting.ts     MODE_LEDGER, salesEntries, receiptEntries, postInvoice, postPayment, unpostInvoice,
                   ledgerPostingHook (db-kit PostingHook)
src/reports.ts     ledgerBalance, ledgerStatement, cashBook, trialBalance, profitAndLoss, balanceSheet,
                   dayBook, outstandingReceivables, gstSummary
scripts/test.ts    the same scenario through db-kit's engine and ledger-kit's, on MongoDB + PostgreSQL;
                   snapshots must be identical; then trial balance per step, locks, atomicity, continuity
```

Every function keeps db-kit 1.1.0's name, signature, voucher numbers, counter keys, audit lines and
error classes (db-kit's `NotFoundError`, `ValidationError`, `PeriodLockedError`; ledger-kit's own
`UnbalancedVoucherError`, a db-kit `ValidationError` with status 422). A database whose books were
posted by db-kit carries on under ledger-kit with no migration. **Any change of behaviour is a
deliberate, versioned decision**: the identity test compares against db-kit, so change it on purpose
(and say so in the PR) or not at all. ledger-kit's `src/` must not import db-kit's accounting
functions (a test enforces it); types, errors and `financialYear` come from db-kit.

## Scope

| ledger-kit owns | It does not own |
| --- | --- |
| Chart of accounts: the 28 standard groups (15 primary + 13 sub-groups), ledgers, opening balances | **Storage**: every table and collection lives in **db-kit** (MongoDB + PostgreSQL, ACID) |
| Vouchers: sales, receipt, payment, journal, contra, credit note, debit note, purchase, closing. Numbering per type per financial year; balanced-entry validation; cancel | GST rules, receivables, partner settlements, cash/bank, lock dates, year-end close: **finance-kit** |
| Automatic posting for invoices and payments, as the implementation of db-kit's `PostingHook` | GraphQL / HTTP: the future **api** repo |
| Books reports: trial balance, ledger statement (running balance), day book, cash and bank books, group summaries, profit & loss, balance sheet | Permissions: **auth-kit** (`accounts:read`, `accounts:post`, `accounts:manage`) |

## Where the code comes from (migration plan)

1. Today the engine lives in **db-kit**: `src/core/accounting.ts` (groups, ledgers, `postVoucher`,
   `cancelVoucher`, `postInvoice`, `postPayment`) and `src/core/reports.ts`.
2. db-kit 1.1.0 already exposes the seam:
   ```ts
   interface PostingHook {
     invoiceIssued(tx: Repositories, invoice: Invoice, actorId?: string): Promise<void>;
     paymentRecorded(tx: Repositories, payment: Payment, invoiceNo: string, actorId?: string): Promise<void>;
     invoiceCancelled(tx: Repositories, invoiceId: string, actorId?: string): Promise<void>;
   }
   ```
3. ledger-kit:
   - ports that logic in, with **identical behaviour** (same voucher numbers, same entries; prove it
     with tests);
   - exports `ledgerPostingHook` for db-kit;
   - exports the posting and report functions finance-kit needs.
4. finance-kit's `src/posting.ts` switches from db-kit's functions to ledger-kit's (one file).
5. Only after that, deprecate the accounting functions in db-kit (re-export from ledger-kit or
   remove them in a major version).

## Rules

1. **Library only.** Functions take `repos: Repositories` from `@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit` (peer
   dependency) and run multi-record work inside `repos.transaction()`.
2. **Money is integer paise.** Every voucher balances: debits = credits, each line one-sided. Reject
   anything else with a typed error.
3. **Respect lock dates.** finance-kit's period locks are stored in db-kit (`periodLocks`). Posting,
   cancelling or editing on or before a lock must fail inside the same transaction.
4. **Indian financial year** (1 Apr – 31 Mar, IST) for numbering and reports.
5. **Tests run on real MongoDB (replica set) and PostgreSQL**, started in-process, the same way as
   db-kit's suite. The trial balance must balance after every scenario.
6. Conventions:
   - TypeScript strict, ESM, tsup, Node ≥ 20, published to GitHub Packages;
   - CI job id **`ci`** (required on `main`), including the `llms-full.txt` freshness check;
   - docs: README, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, llms.txt, llms-full.txt (`scripts/llms-full.mjs`);
   - LICENSE: all rights reserved.
7. **Name.** "Tally" is a trademark of Tally Solutions. Keep the README clear that this is our own
   independent software, not affiliated with Tally Solutions, and confirm the final package name
   with the owner before the first release.
8. Never commit patient data, real signatures, secrets or `.env` files.

## Commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
npm run llms      # regenerate llms-full.txt (CI fails when it is stale)
```

`npm test` downloads MongoDB and PostgreSQL binaries on first run. Behind a proxy that blocks them, set
`MONGOMS_SYSTEM_BINARY` to a local `mongod`. db-kit comes from GitHub Packages (scope
`@mgpl-diagnostics` → `https://npm.pkg.github.com`, a token with `read:packages`).

## Repository rules

`main` takes pull requests only:
- squash merge, linear history;
- 1 code-owner review (`@BackStacked`);
- the `ci` check is required;
- release tags `v*` are admin-only. `publish.yml` publishes on a `v*` tag, or when the code owner runs
  it by hand on `main` (the version in package.json). Bump the version in a PR first.

Rules are applied from `mgpl-diagnostics/.github` (`scripts/protect-repos.mjs`).

## File: llms.txt

# @mgpl-diagnostics/ledger-kit

> The MGPL Diagnostics accounting engine: account groups, ledgers, vouchers, double-entry posting, and books reports (trial balance, ledger statement, day book, cash/bank books, P&L, balance sheet). A library on db-kit's repositories (MongoDB or PostgreSQL, ACID, integer paise). It implements db-kit's PostingHook and serves finance-kit. Our own software, Tally-like in concepts only, with no Tally import or export.

Key facts for agents:
- Status: 0.1.0 on GitHub Packages; finance-kit posts through it. A port of db-kit 1.1.0's accounting.ts / reports.ts with identical behaviour (same names, signatures, voucher numbers, entries, errors, report figures); npm test proves it on MongoDB and PostgreSQL.
- `createDb({ ..., posting: ledgerPostingHook })` makes db-kit's billing post through ledger-kit.
- Calls: seedChartOfAccounts, postVoucher, cancelVoucher (both refuse a locked period: PeriodLockedError 409), assertBalanced (UnbalancedVoucherError 422), postInvoice, postPayment, unpostInvoice; reports: ledgerBalance, ledgerStatement, cashBook, trialBalance, profitAndLoss, balanceSheet, dayBook, outstandingReceivables, gstSummary.
- Peer dependency: @mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit (>= 1.1.0, which has PostingHook and periodLocks). Types, errors and financialYear come from db-kit; src/ must not import db-kit's accounting functions.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it does, use, API
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): map, scope, migration plan, rules
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): every doc and source file in one document

## Source

- [src/chart.ts](src/chart.ts): groups, default ledgers, seeding
- [src/vouchers.ts](src/vouchers.ts): numbering, balance check, lock dates, post / cancel
- [src/posting.ts](src/posting.ts): automatic posting, ledgerPostingHook
- [src/reports.ts](src/reports.ts): books reports

- [finance-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit)

## File: scripts/llms-full.mjs

````js
// Builds llms-full.txt: every doc and source file of the repo in one plain-text document for AI tools.
//   node scripts/llms-full.mjs "<title>" <file-or-folder> [file-or-folder …]
// Folders are walked recursively. Output order: README, AGENTS, docs, then the rest alphabetically.
// Skipped: build output, dependencies, lockfiles, generated files, binaries. Files over 150 KB are
// listed (path + size) instead of inlined. CI checks the file is up to date (`npm run llms` + git diff).
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { extname, join, relative } from "node:path";

const [title, ...inputs] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!title || !inputs.length) {
  console.error('usage: node scripts/llms-full.mjs "<title>" <file-or-folder> …');
  process.exit(1);
}

const TEXT = new Set([".ts", ".tsx", ".mts", ".cts", ".js", ".mjs", ".cjs", ".md", ".mdx", ".json", ".css", ".yml", ".yaml", ".txt", ".graphql", ".gql", ".sql", ".html"]);
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(["node_modules", "dist", ".next", ".git", ".turbo", "coverage", "examples", ".pg-test"]);
const SKIP_FILES = /(^|\/)(package-lock\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml|yarn\.lock|llms-full\.txt|[^/]*\.generated\.[^/]+|[^/]*\.log)$/;
const MAX = 150 * 1024;
const LANG = { ".ts": "ts", ".tsx": "tsx", ".mts": "ts", ".cts": "ts", ".js": "js", ".mjs": "js", ".cjs": "js", ".json": "json", ".css": "css", ".yml": "yaml", ".yaml": "yaml", ".graphql": "graphql", ".gql": "graphql", ".sql": "sql", ".html": "html" };

const posix = (p) => p.split("\\").join("/");
const files = new Set();
function walk(p) {
  const st = statSync(p);
  if (st.isDirectory()) {
    for (const name of readdirSync(p)) if (!SKIP_DIRS.has(name)) walk(join(p, name));
  } else if (TEXT.has(extname(p).toLowerCase()) && !SKIP_FILES.test(posix(p))) {
    files.add(posix(relative(".", p)));
  }
}
for (const input of inputs) walk(input);

const rank = (f) => (/^README\.md$/i.test(f) ? 0 : /^AGENTS\.md$/i.test(f) ? 1 : /^docs\//.test(f) ? 2 : 3);
const ordered = [...files].sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b) || (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));

const parts = [`# ${title} — full documentation and source\n\n> Generated by scripts/llms-full.mjs. Do not edit by hand. ${ordered.length} files.\n\n## Contents\n\n${ordered.map((f) => `- ${f}`).join("\n")}\n`];
const omitted = [];
for (const f of ordered) {
  // LF-normalised text, so Windows and Linux checkouts produce byte-identical output
  const body = readFileSync(f, "utf8").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").trim();
  const size = Buffer.byteLength(body);
  if (size > MAX) {
    omitted.push(`${f} (${(size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB)`);
    parts.push(`\n\n---\n\n## File: ${f}\n\n_Omitted: ${(size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB. Read the file directly._\n`);
    continue;
  }
  const lang = LANG[extname(f).toLowerCase()];
  const fence = body.includes("```") ? "````" : "```";
  parts.push(`\n\n---\n\n## File: ${f}\n\n${lang ? `${fence}${lang}\n${body}\n${fence}` : body}\n`);
}
const out = parts.join("");
writeFileSync("llms-full.txt", out);
console.log(`llms-full.txt: ${ordered.length} files, ${(out.length / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB${omitted.length ? `; omitted (too large): ${omitted.join(", ")}` : ""}`);
````

## File: scripts/test.ts

```ts
// npm test — ledger-kit on real MongoDB (single-node replica set) and real PostgreSQL, both started
// in-process, through db-kit's repositories.
//
// The same scenario runs twice on each database, into two fresh databases: once with db-kit 1.1.0's
// accounting (its default posting and its functions), once with ledger-kit's (ledgerPostingHook and
// ledger-kit's functions). Every voucher, ledger entry, audit line, error and report is snapshotted with
// ids replaced by names; the two snapshots must be identical. Then ledger-kit-only checks: the trial
// balance after every step, lock dates under concurrency, atomicity, carrying on a db-kit series, and
// the engine boundary (ledger-kit must not call db-kit's accounting).
//
// Fictional organisation and people only.
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { isDeepStrictEqual } from "node:util";
import EmbeddedPostgres from "embedded-postgres";
import { MongoMemoryReplSet } from "mongodb-memory-server";
import * as dbkit from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import {
  cancelInvoice, ConflictError, createDb, issueInvoice, NotFoundError, PeriodLockedError, recordPayment, registerPatient, seedOrganization,
  ValidationError, type Backend, type Db, type Id, type PostingHook, type Repositories,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import * as ledger from "../src/index";

let failed = 0;
let passed = 0;
const ok = (cond: unknown, msg: string) => {
  if (cond) { passed++; console.log(`  ok    ${msg}`); }
  else { failed++; console.log(`  FAIL  ${msg}`); }
};
const rejects = async (p: Promise<unknown>, type: new (...a: any[]) => Error, msg: string) => {
  try { await p; ok(false, `${msg} (no error)`); } catch (e) { ok(e instanceof type, `${msg}${e instanceof type ? "" : ` (got ${(e as Error).name}: ${(e as Error).message})`}`); }
};
const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
const START = Date.now();

/** IST wall-clock time → Date. */
const at = (day: string, time = "10:00") => new Date(`${day}T${time}:00+05:30`);
const FY25 = { from: at("2025-04-01", "00:00"), to: new Date(at("2026-04-01", "00:00").getTime() - 1) };
const FY26 = { from: at("2026-04-01", "00:00"), to: new Date(at("2027-04-01", "00:00").getTime() - 1) };
const EVER = { from: at("2020-01-01"), to: new Date(START + 365 * 86400000) };

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ engines

/** Everything the scenario calls on an accounting engine. */
interface Engine {
  name: "db-kit" | "ledger-kit";
  /** The posting hook billing uses (undefined = db-kit's default). */
  hook?: PostingHook;
  seedChartOfAccounts: typeof ledger.seedChartOfAccounts;
  postVoucher: typeof ledger.postVoucher;
  cancelVoucher: typeof ledger.cancelVoucher;
  postInvoice: typeof ledger.postInvoice;
  postPayment: typeof ledger.postPayment;
  assertBalanced: typeof ledger.assertBalanced;
  salesEntries: typeof ledger.salesEntries;
  receiptEntries: typeof ledger.receiptEntries;
  ledgerBalance: typeof ledger.ledgerBalance;
  ledgerStatement: typeof ledger.ledgerStatement;
  cashBook: typeof ledger.cashBook;
  trialBalance: typeof ledger.trialBalance;
  profitAndLoss: typeof ledger.profitAndLoss;
  balanceSheet: typeof ledger.balanceSheet;
  dayBook: typeof ledger.dayBook;
  outstandingReceivables: typeof ledger.outstandingReceivables;
  gstSummary: typeof ledger.gstSummary;
  constants: unknown;
}

const DBKIT: Engine = {
  name: "db-kit", hook: undefined,
  seedChartOfAccounts: dbkit.seedChartOfAccounts, postVoucher: dbkit.postVoucher, cancelVoucher: dbkit.cancelVoucher,
  postInvoice: dbkit.postInvoice, postPayment: dbkit.postPayment, assertBalanced: dbkit.assertBalanced,
  salesEntries: dbkit.salesEntries, receiptEntries: dbkit.receiptEntries,
  ledgerBalance: dbkit.ledgerBalance, ledgerStatement: dbkit.ledgerStatement, cashBook: dbkit.cashBook, trialBalance: dbkit.trialBalance,
  profitAndLoss: dbkit.profitAndLoss, balanceSheet: dbkit.balanceSheet, dayBook: dbkit.dayBook,
  outstandingReceivables: dbkit.outstandingReceivables, gstSummary: dbkit.gstSummary,
  constants: { groups: dbkit.TALLY_GROUPS, ledgers: dbkit.DEFAULT_LEDGERS, prefix: dbkit.VOUCHER_PREFIX, key: dbkit.voucherCounterKey("o", "sales", "2026-27") },
};

const LEDGER: Engine = {
  name: "ledger-kit", hook: ledger.ledgerPostingHook,
  seedChartOfAccounts: ledger.seedChartOfAccounts, postVoucher: ledger.postVoucher, cancelVoucher: ledger.cancelVoucher,
  postInvoice: ledger.postInvoice, postPayment: ledger.postPayment, assertBalanced: ledger.assertBalanced,
  salesEntries: ledger.salesEntries, receiptEntries: ledger.receiptEntries,
  ledgerBalance: ledger.ledgerBalance, ledgerStatement: ledger.ledgerStatement, cashBook: ledger.cashBook, trialBalance: ledger.trialBalance,
  profitAndLoss: ledger.profitAndLoss, balanceSheet: ledger.balanceSheet, dayBook: ledger.dayBook,
  outstandingReceivables: ledger.outstandingReceivables, gstSummary: ledger.gstSummary,
  constants: { groups: ledger.TALLY_GROUPS, ledgers: ledger.DEFAULT_LEDGERS, prefix: ledger.VOUCHER_PREFIX, key: ledger.voucherCounterKey("o", "sales", "2026-27") },
};

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the scenario

type Snapshot = Record<string, unknown>;

/** An error as data: class name, message, HTTP status. */
async function outcome(p: Promise<unknown> | (() => unknown)): Promise<unknown> {
  try {
    return { ok: await (typeof p === "function" ? p() : p) };
  } catch (e) {
    const err = e as Error & { statusCode?: number };
    return { error: err.name, message: err.message, statusCode: err.statusCode, validation: e instanceof ValidationError, conflict: e instanceof ConflictError, notFound: e instanceof NotFoundError };
  }
}

/**
 * One lab's books, start to finish: two financial years, two branches, every voucher type, GST
 * intra- and inter-state, round-off both ways, partial payments in every mode, a refund, a
 * cancelled invoice, lock dates, rejected vouchers, and every report org-wide and per branch.
 * `step` runs after each stage (the trial balance check).
 */
async function scenario(r: Repositories, e: Engine, step: (label: string, orgId: Id) => Promise<void>): Promise<Snapshot> {
  const snap: Snapshot = { constants: e.constants };
  const { org, branch: rpr, owner } = await seedOrganization(r, {
    org: { name: "Sunrise Diagnostics", code: "SUN", gstin: "22AAAAA0000A1Z5" },
    branch: { code: "RPR01", name: "Raipur" },
    owner: { name: "Asha Rao", email: "asha@example.com", passwordHash: "scrypt$test" },
  });
  const orgId = org.id;
  const bls = await r.branches.create({ orgId, code: "BLS01", name: "Bilaspur", kind: "collection_center", active: true });

  // an organisation without a chart of accounts: billing posts nothing
  const bare = await seedOrganization(r, {
    org: { name: "No Books Lab", code: "NOB" }, branch: { code: "NB01", name: "Main" },
    owner: { name: "Ravi Iyer", email: "ravi@example.com", passwordHash: "scrypt$test" },
  });
  const bareP = await registerPatient(r, { orgId: bare.org.id, branchId: bare.branch.id, name: "Meena Das", sex: "female", ageYears: 40 });
  const bareInv = await issueInvoice(r, { orgId: bare.org.id, branchId: bare.branch.id, patientId: bareP.id, items: [{ name: "ESR", ratePaise: 9900 }], payments: [{ amountPaise: 9900, mode: "cash" }], date: at("2026-03-02") });
  snap.withoutChart = {
    vouchers: await r.vouchers.count({ orgId: bare.org.id }),
    postInvoice: await e.postInvoice(r, bareInv.invoice),
    postPayment: await e.postPayment(r, bareInv.payments[0]!, bareInv.invoice.invoiceNo),
    cashBook: await outcome(e.cashBook(r, { orgId: bare.org.id, ...FY25 })),
  };

  // chart of accounts
  const coa = await e.seedChartOfAccounts(r, orgId);
  const again = await e.seedChartOfAccounts(r, orgId);
  snap.chart = { groups: coa.groups, ledgers: coa.ledgers, againGroups: again.groups.length, againLedgers: again.ledgers.length };
  const L = Object.fromEntries((await r.ledgers.find({ orgId })).map((l) => [l.systemKey ?? l.name, l.id]));
  // balanced opening balances (equipment brought in as capital)
  await r.ledgers.update(L["Lab Equipment"]!, { openingPaise: 50000000 });
  await r.ledgers.update(L.capital!, { openingPaise: -50000000 });
  await step("chart of accounts + opening balances", orgId);

  // pure functions
  const ledgerMap = new Map((await r.ledgers.find({ orgId })).filter((l) => l.systemKey).map((l) => [l.systemKey!, l]));
  const fakeInvoice = { id: "inv", items: [{ amountPaise: 9000, discountPaise: 1000 }], taxPaise: 15, totalPaise: 9000, discountPaise: 1000, roundOffPaise: -15 } as any;
  snap.pure = {
    sales: e.salesEntries(fakeInvoice, ledgerMap), salesInterState: e.salesEntries(fakeInvoice, ledgerMap, true),
    receipt: e.receiptEntries({ mode: "wallet", kind: "payment", amountPaise: 500, invoiceId: "inv" } as any, ledgerMap),
    refund: e.receiptEntries({ mode: "cheque", kind: "refund", amountPaise: 500, invoiceId: "inv" } as any, ledgerMap),
    balanced: await outcome(() => e.assertBalanced([{ ledgerId: "a", debitPaise: 1, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: "b", debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 1 }])),
    oneLine: await outcome(() => e.assertBalanced([{ ledgerId: "a", debitPaise: 1, creditPaise: 0 }])),
    unbalanced: await outcome(() => e.assertBalanced([{ ledgerId: "a", debitPaise: 2, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: "b", debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 1 }])),
    twoSided: await outcome(() => e.assertBalanced([{ ledgerId: "a", debitPaise: 1, creditPaise: 1 }, { ledgerId: "b", debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 0 }])),
    fractional: await outcome(() => e.assertBalanced([{ ledgerId: "a", debitPaise: 1.5, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: "b", debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 1.5 }])),
    negative: await outcome(() => e.assertBalanced([{ ledgerId: "a", debitPaise: -1, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: "b", debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: -1 }])),
  };

  // billing (db-kit workflows; they post through the engine's hook)
  const p1 = await registerPatient(r, { orgId, branchId: rpr.id, name: "Kiran Mehta", sex: "female", ageYears: 31 });
  const p2 = await registerPatient(r, { orgId, branchId: bls.id, name: "Arjun Nair", sex: "male", ageYears: 52 });
  const inv1 = await issueInvoice(r, {
    orgId, branchId: rpr.id, patientId: p1.id, date: at("2026-03-20"),
    items: [
      { code: "CBC", name: "Complete Blood Count", ratePaise: 39900 },
      { code: "LFT", name: "Liver Function Tests", ratePaise: 64900, discountPaise: 4900 },
      { code: "SYR5", name: "Syringe 5 ml", category: "consumable", qty: 2, ratePaise: 1000, taxPercent: 12 },
    ],
    billDiscountPaise: 5000, payments: [{ amountPaise: 50000, mode: "cash" }],
  }, owner.id);
  // round-off down (1120 → 1100) and up (1180 → 1200), odd tax split (15 → 7 + 8)
  const inv2 = await issueInvoice(r, { orgId, branchId: rpr.id, patientId: p1.id, date: at("2026-03-31", "23:30"), items: [{ name: "Kit A", category: "consumable", ratePaise: 1000, taxPercent: 12 }] });
  const inv3 = await issueInvoice(r, { orgId, branchId: rpr.id, patientId: p2.id, date: at("2026-04-01", "00:30"), items: [{ name: "Kit B", category: "consumable", ratePaise: 1000, taxPercent: 18 }], payments: [{ amountPaise: 1200, mode: "card" }] });
  const inv4 = await issueInvoice(r, { orgId, branchId: bls.id, patientId: p2.id, date: at("2026-04-02"), items: [{ name: "Swab", category: "consumable", ratePaise: 125, taxPercent: 12 }, { name: "TSH", ratePaise: 29900 }] });
  await step("invoices across the financial-year boundary", orgId);

  for (const mode of ["upi", "card", "netbanking", "wallet", "cheque"] as const) await recordPayment(r, { invoiceId: inv1.invoice.id, amountPaise: 7000, mode }, owner.id);
  await recordPayment(r, { invoiceId: inv1.invoice.id, amountPaise: 5000, mode: "cash", kind: "refund" }, owner.id);
  await recordPayment(r, { invoiceId: inv2.invoice.id, amountPaise: 1100, mode: "insurance" });
  await step("payments in every mode + a refund", orgId);

  // inter-state invoice (IGST)
  await r.orgs.update(orgId, { settings: { interState: true } });
  const inv5 = await issueInvoice(r, { orgId, branchId: rpr.id, patientId: p1.id, date: at("2026-04-05"), items: [{ name: "Kit C", category: "consumable", ratePaise: 10000, taxPercent: 12 }] });
  await r.orgs.update(orgId, { settings: {} });
  // a cancelled invoice
  const inv6 = await issueInvoice(r, { orgId, branchId: bls.id, patientId: p2.id, date: at("2026-04-06"), items: [{ name: "Blood Group", ratePaise: 11900 }] });
  await cancelInvoice(r, inv6.invoice.id, "duplicate", owner.id);
  await step("IGST invoice + a cancelled invoice", orgId);
  snap.invoices = [inv1, inv2, inv3, inv4, inv5, inv6].map((x) => x.invoice.invoiceNo);

  // manual vouchers of every type
  const jv = (type: ledger.VoucherInput["type"], date: Date, dr: string, cr: string, paise: number, branchId: Id = rpr.id, narration?: string) =>
    e.postVoucher(r, { orgId, branchId, type, date, narration, entries: [{ ledgerId: L[dr]!, debitPaise: paise, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: L[cr]!, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: paise }] }, owner.id);
  await jv("receipt", at("2026-03-01"), "cash", "capital", 1000000, rpr.id, "Capital introduced");
  await jv("contra", at("2026-03-02"), "bank", "cash", 400000, rpr.id, "Cash deposited");
  await jv("payment", at("2026-03-05"), "Rent", "bank", 150000, rpr.id, "March rent");
  await jv("purchase", at("2026-03-06"), "purchases", "bank", 80000, bls.id);
  await jv("journal", at("2026-03-31", "23:59"), "Salaries", "doctors_payable", 20000);
  await jv("journal", at("2026-04-01", "00:00"), "Electricity", "cash", 3000);
  await jv("credit_note", at("2026-04-03"), "sales", "receivables", 1000);
  await jv("debit_note", at("2026-04-04"), "receivables", "sales", 500, bls.id);
  const zeroLines = await e.postVoucher(r, { orgId, branchId: rpr.id, type: "journal", date: at("2026-04-07"), entries: [
    { ledgerId: L.cash!, debitPaise: 700, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: L.bank!, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: L.upi!, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 700 },
  ] });
  const closing = await jv("closing", at("2026-03-31", "23:59"), "sales", "capital", 2500);
  const toCancel = await jv("journal", at("2026-04-08"), "Rent", "cash", 999);
  snap.cancelled = [await e.cancelVoucher(r, toCancel.id, owner.id), await e.cancelVoucher(r, toCancel.id, owner.id)];
  snap.zeroLines = zeroLines.entries.length;
  await step("manual vouchers of every type", orgId);

  // rejected vouchers
  const bad = (entries: ledger.VoucherInput["entries"]) => outcome(e.postVoucher(r, { orgId, branchId: rpr.id, type: "journal", date: at("2026-04-09"), entries }));
  snap.rejected = {
    unbalanced: await bad([{ ledgerId: L.cash!, debitPaise: 100, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: L.bank!, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 90 }]),
    oneLine: await bad([{ ledgerId: L.cash!, debitPaise: 100, creditPaise: 0 }]),
    fractional: await bad([{ ledgerId: L.cash!, debitPaise: 0.5, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: L.bank!, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 0.5 }]),
    twoSided: await bad([{ ledgerId: L.cash!, debitPaise: 100, creditPaise: 100 }, { ledgerId: L.bank!, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 0 }]),
    unknownLedger: await bad([{ ledgerId: L.cash!, debitPaise: 100, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 100 }]),
    unknownVoucher: await outcome(e.cancelVoucher(r, "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002")),
  };
  snap.countersAfterRejects = await r.counters.peek(ledger.voucherCounterKey(orgId, "journal", "2026-27"));
  await step("rejected vouchers leave nothing behind", orgId);

  // lock dates: branch lock, then org lock
  const setLock = (scope: string, lockedUpTo: Date | null) => r.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [l] = await tx.periodLocks.hold(orgId, [scope], "update");
    await tx.periodLocks.update(l!.id, { lockedUpTo });
  });
  const marchPurchase = (await r.vouchers.find({ orgId, type: "purchase" }))[0]!;
  await setLock(bls.id, new Date(at("2026-04-01", "00:00").getTime() - 1));
  snap.branchLock = {
    onLockDay: await outcome(jv("journal", at("2026-03-31", "18:00"), "cash", "capital", 100, bls.id)),
    otherBranch: await outcome(jv("journal", at("2026-03-31", "18:00"), "cash", "capital", 100, rpr.id)),
    afterLock: await outcome(jv("journal", at("2026-04-01", "00:00"), "cash", "capital", 100, bls.id)),
    cancelLocked: await outcome(e.cancelVoucher(r, marchPurchase.id)),
    invoiceInLockedPeriod: await outcome(issueInvoice(r, { orgId, branchId: bls.id, patientId: p2.id, date: at("2026-03-15"), items: [{ name: "ESR", ratePaise: 9900 }] })),
  };
  await setLock("org", at("2026-03-10", "23:59"));
  snap.orgLock = {
    rpr: await outcome(jv("journal", at("2026-03-10"), "cash", "capital", 100, rpr.id)),
    rprLater: await outcome(jv("journal", at("2026-03-11"), "cash", "capital", 100, rpr.id)),
  };
  await setLock("org", null);
  await setLock(bls.id, null);
  await step("lock dates", orgId);

  // reports
  const ledgers = await r.ledgers.find({ orgId });
  const scopes: { label: string; branchId?: Id }[] = [{ label: "org" }, { label: "RPR01", branchId: rpr.id }, { label: "BLS01", branchId: bls.id }];
  const reports: Snapshot = {};
  for (const s of scopes) {
    const q = { orgId, branchId: s.branchId };
    reports[s.label] = {
      trialBalance: await e.trialBalance(r, q),
      trialBalanceFY25: await e.trialBalance(r, { ...q, asOf: FY25.to }),
      trialBalanceMidMarch: await e.trialBalance(r, { ...q, asOf: at("2026-03-15") }),
      balances: Object.fromEntries(await Promise.all(ledgers.map(async (l) => [l.name, await e.ledgerBalance(r, { ...q, ledgerId: l.id })]))),
      balancesFY25: Object.fromEntries(await Promise.all(ledgers.map(async (l) => [l.name, await e.ledgerBalance(r, { ...q, ledgerId: l.id, asOf: FY25.to })]))),
      receivablesFY26: await e.ledgerStatement(r, { ...q, ledgerId: L.receivables!, ...FY26 }),
      receivablesEver: await e.ledgerStatement(r, { ...q, ledgerId: L.receivables!, ...EVER }),
      bankFY25: await e.ledgerStatement(r, { ...q, ledgerId: L.bank!, ...FY25 }),
      salesFY26: await e.ledgerStatement(r, { ...q, ledgerId: L.sales!, ...FY26 }),
      cashBookFY25: await e.cashBook(r, { ...q, ...FY25 }),
      cashBookFY26: await e.cashBook(r, { ...q, ...FY26 }),
      cashBookEver: await e.cashBook(r, { ...q, ...EVER }),
      profitAndLossFY25: await e.profitAndLoss(r, { ...q, ...FY25 }),
      profitAndLossFY26: await e.profitAndLoss(r, { ...q, ...FY26 }),
      profitAndLossEver: await e.profitAndLoss(r, { ...q, ...EVER }),
      balanceSheetFY25: await e.balanceSheet(r, { ...q, asOf: FY25.to }),
      balanceSheetNow: await e.balanceSheet(r, { ...q, asOf: EVER.to }),
      dayBook: await e.dayBook(r, { ...q, ...EVER }),
      dayBookFY25Journal: await e.dayBook(r, { ...q, ...FY25, type: "journal" }),
      dayBookSales: await e.dayBook(r, { ...q, ...EVER, type: "sales" }),
      outstanding: await e.outstandingReceivables(r, { ...q, asOf: at("2026-06-15") }),
      outstandingLater: await e.outstandingReceivables(r, { ...q, asOf: at("2026-07-30") }),
      gstFY25: await e.gstSummary(r, { ...q, ...FY25 }),
      gstFY26: await e.gstSummary(r, { ...q, ...FY26 }),
    };
  }
  reports.unknownLedger = await outcome(e.ledgerBalance(r, { orgId, ledgerId: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003" }));
  reports.unknownStatement = await outcome(e.ledgerStatement(r, { orgId, ledgerId: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003", ...FY25 }));
  snap.reports = reports;

  // the stored books
  snap.vouchers = await r.vouchers.listByDate({ orgId, includeCancelled: true });
  snap.ledgerEntries = await r.ledgerEntries.list({ orgId });
  snap.audit = (await r.audit.find({ orgId })).filter((a) => a.action.startsWith("voucher.")).map((a) => ({ action: a.action, entityId: a.entityId, data: a.data, userId: a.userId }));
  snap.closing = closing.voucherNo;
  return snap;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ normalising a snapshot

const UUID = /[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}|\b[0-9a-f]{24}\b/g;

/** id → readable label (ledger name, voucher number, invoice number…), for one database. */
async function labels(r: Repositories): Promise<Map<string, string>> {
  const m = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const o of await r.orgs.find()) m.set(o.id, `org:${o.code}`);
  for (const b of await r.branches.find()) m.set(b.id, `branch:${b.code}`);
  for (const u of await r.users.find()) m.set(u.id, `user:${u.email}`);
  for (const p of await r.patients.find()) m.set(p.id, `patient:${p.uhid}`);
  for (const g of await r.accountGroups.find()) m.set(g.id, `group:${g.name}`);
  for (const l of await r.ledgers.find()) m.set(l.id, `ledger:${l.name}`);
  for (const i of await r.invoices.find()) m.set(i.id, `invoice:${i.invoiceNo}`);
  const vouchers = await r.vouchers.find();
  for (const v of vouchers) m.set(v.id, `voucher:${v.voucherNo}`);
  for (const v of vouchers) if (v.paymentId) m.set(v.paymentId, `payment:${v.voucherNo}`);
  for (const t of ["00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003"]) m.set(t, `missing:${t.slice(-1)}`);
  return m;
}

const SKIP = new Set(["id", "createdAt", "updatedAt", "at"]);

/** Ids → labels, Dates → ISO (or "now" for the ones taken from the clock), timestamps dropped. */
function normalise(x: unknown, ids: Map<string, string>): unknown {
  if (x instanceof Date) return Math.abs(x.getTime() - Date.now()) < 3600_000 ? "now" : x.toISOString();
  if (typeof x === "string") return x.replace(UUID, (s) => ids.get(s) ?? `UNKNOWN-ID`);
  if (Array.isArray(x)) return x.map((v) => normalise(v, ids));
  if (x instanceof Map) return normalise(Object.fromEntries(x), ids);
  if (x && typeof x === "object") {
    const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(x)) if (!SKIP.has(k) && v !== undefined) out[k] = normalise(v, ids);
    return out;
  }
  return x;
}

/** First differing path between two normalised values, for a readable failure. */
function firstDiff(a: unknown, b: unknown, path = ""): string | null {
  if (isDeepStrictEqual(a, b)) return null;
  if (a && b && typeof a === "object" && typeof b === "object") {
    for (const k of new Set([...Object.keys(a), ...Object.keys(b)])) {
      const d = firstDiff((a as any)[k], (b as any)[k], `${path}.${k}`);
      if (d) return d;
    }
  }
  return `${path}: ${JSON.stringify(a)?.slice(0, 300)} ≠ ${JSON.stringify(b)?.slice(0, 300)}`;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ per backend

type Open = (name: string, posting?: PostingHook) => Promise<Db>;

async function backendSuite(backend: Backend, open: Open) {
  const tag = `[${backend}]`;

  // 1. identical behaviour: db-kit's engine and ledger-kit's on fresh databases, same scenario
  console.log(`\n${tag} identical behaviour: db-kit 1.1.0 accounting vs ledger-kit`);
  const snaps: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const e of [DBKIT, LEDGER]) {
    const db = await open(e.name === "db-kit" ? "books_dbkit" : "books_ledger", e.hook);
    const r = db.rawRepos;
    const step = async (label: string, orgId: Id) => {
      const tb = await e.trialBalance(r, { orgId });
      const bs = await e.balanceSheet(r, { orgId, asOf: EVER.to });
      if (e.name === "ledger-kit")
        ok(tb.differencePaise === 0 && tb.totalDebitPaise === tb.totalCreditPaise && bs.differencePaise === 0, `${tag} trial balance and balance sheet balance after: ${label} (Dr ${tb.totalDebitPaise} = Cr ${tb.totalCreditPaise})`);
    };
    const raw = await scenario(r, e, step);
    const n = normalise(raw, await labels(r)) as Snapshot;
    // row order between equal keys (lines of one voucher, audit lines) is the database's, not the engine's
    for (const k of ["ledgerEntries", "audit"]) n[k] = (n[k] as unknown[]).map((x) => JSON.stringify(x)).sort().map((x) => JSON.parse(x));
    snaps[e.name] = n;
    await db.close();
  }
  const a = snaps["db-kit"] as Snapshot;
  const b = snaps["ledger-kit"] as Snapshot;
  ok(!JSON.stringify(b).includes("UNKNOWN-ID"), `${tag} every id in the snapshot maps to a name`);
  for (const k of Object.keys(a)) {
    const d = firstDiff(a[k], b[k], k);
    ok(!d, `${tag} identical: ${k}${d ? ` — ${d}` : ""}`);
  }
  ok(Object.keys(a).length === Object.keys(b).length, `${tag} same snapshot sections (${Object.keys(a).length})`);

  // a few anchors, so "identical" cannot mean "identically empty"
  const v = b.vouchers as { voucherNo: string; status: string; type: string }[];
  const nos = v.map((x) => x.voucherNo);
  ok(nos.includes("SAL/2025-26/000002") && nos.includes("SAL/2026-27/000001") && nos.includes("JRN/2025-26/000001") && nos.includes("JRN/2026-27/000001"), `${tag} numbering restarts on 1 April IST (${v.length} vouchers)`);
  ok(new Set(v.map((x) => x.type)).size === 9, `${tag} all nine voucher types posted`);
  ok(v.filter((x) => x.status === "cancelled").length === 2, `${tag} two cancelled vouchers keep their numbers`);
  const rep = b.reports as any;
  ok(rep.org.trialBalance.rows.length > 10 && rep.org.gstFY26.igstPaise === 1200 && rep.org.gstFY26.cgstPaise > 0, `${tag} reports carry real numbers (IGST ${rep.org.gstFY26.igstPaise}, CGST ${rep.org.gstFY26.cgstPaise})`);
  ok((b.branchLock as any).onLockDay.error === "PeriodLockedError" && (b.branchLock as any).otherBranch.ok, `${tag} lock dates refuse the locked branch only`);
  ok((b.withoutChart as any).vouchers === 0 && (b.withoutChart as any).postInvoice === null, `${tag} no chart of accounts: nothing posted`);

  // 2. ledger-kit carries on a series db-kit started (same counters, same numbers)
  console.log(`${tag} switching an existing database from db-kit to ledger-kit`);
  const old = await open("books_dbkit", ledger.ledgerPostingHook);
  const r = old.rawRepos;
  const org = (await r.orgs.findOne({ code: "SUN" }))!;
  const rpr = (await r.branches.findOne({ orgId: org.id, code: "RPR01" }))!;
  const cash = (await r.ledgers.findBySystemKey(org.id, "cash"))!;
  const capital = (await r.ledgers.findBySystemKey(org.id, "capital"))!;
  const lastJrn = (await r.vouchers.find({ orgId: org.id, type: "journal" })).map((x) => x.voucherNo).filter((n) => n.startsWith("JRN/2026-27/")).sort().at(-1)!;
  const next = await ledger.postVoucher(r, { orgId: org.id, branchId: rpr.id, type: "journal", date: at("2026-05-01"), entries: [{ ledgerId: cash.id, debitPaise: 100, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: capital.id, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 100 }] });
  ok(Number(next.voucherNo.slice(-6)) === Number(lastJrn.slice(-6)) + 1, `${tag} ledger-kit continues db-kit's series: ${lastJrn} → ${next.voucherNo}`);
  const patient = (await r.patients.find({ orgId: org.id }))[0]!;
  const lastSal = (await r.vouchers.find({ orgId: org.id, type: "sales" })).map((x) => x.voucherNo).filter((n) => n.startsWith("SAL/2026-27/")).sort().at(-1)!;
  const inv = await issueInvoice(r, { orgId: org.id, branchId: rpr.id, patientId: patient.id, date: at("2026-05-02"), items: [{ name: "ESR", ratePaise: 9900 }], payments: [{ amountPaise: 9900, mode: "upi" }] });
  const sal = (await r.vouchers.find({ invoiceId: inv.invoice.id } as any)).map((x) => x.voucherNo).sort();
  ok(sal.includes(`SAL/2026-27/${String(Number(lastSal.slice(-6)) + 1).padStart(6, "0")}`) && sal.some((n) => n.startsWith("RCT/")), `${tag} ledgerPostingHook posts the next sales and receipt vouchers (${sal.join(", ")})`);
  await dbkit.cancelVoucher(r, next.id);
  ok((await ledger.trialBalance(r, { orgId: org.id })).differencePaise === 0 && (await dbkit.trialBalance(r, { orgId: org.id })).totalDebitPaise === (await ledger.trialBalance(r, { orgId: org.id })).totalDebitPaise, `${tag} mixed history: both engines read the same balanced books`);

  // 3. ledgerPostingHook runs inside billing's transaction: a failure rolls the invoice back
  const invoicesBefore = await r.invoices.count({ orgId: org.id });
  const vouchersBefore = await r.vouchers.count({ orgId: org.id });
  const failing = await open("books_dbkit", {
    ...ledger.ledgerPostingHook,
    async paymentRecorded(tx, p, no, a) { await ledger.ledgerPostingHook.paymentRecorded(tx, p, no, a); throw new ConflictError("posting failed"); },
  });
  await rejects(issueInvoice(failing.rawRepos, { orgId: org.id, branchId: rpr.id, patientId: patient.id, date: at("2026-05-03"), items: [{ name: "ESR", ratePaise: 9900 }], payments: [{ amountPaise: 100, mode: "cash" }] }), ConflictError, `${tag} a failing hook fails the invoice`);
  ok((await r.invoices.count({ orgId: org.id })) === invoicesBefore && (await r.vouchers.count({ orgId: org.id })) === vouchersBefore, `${tag} …and rolls back the invoice and its vouchers`);
  await failing.close();

  // 4. atomicity: a voucher posted inside a failing transaction leaves no voucher, entry or number
  const key = ledger.voucherCounterKey(org.id, "journal", "2026-27");
  const seq = await r.counters.peek(key);
  const entries = (await r.ledgerEntries.list({ orgId: org.id })).length;
  await rejects(r.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await ledger.postVoucher(tx, { orgId: org.id, branchId: rpr.id, type: "journal", date: at("2026-05-04"), entries: [{ ledgerId: cash.id, debitPaise: 100, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: capital.id, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 100 }] });
    throw new ConflictError("boom");
  }), ConflictError, `${tag} error after postVoucher inside a transaction propagates`);
  ok((await r.counters.peek(key)) === seq && (await r.ledgerEntries.list({ orgId: org.id })).length === entries, `${tag} rollback: no voucher number used, no ledger entries`);

  // 5. lock dates under concurrency: a lock moved while a posting is in flight still stops it
  let lockHeld!: () => void;
  const holding = new Promise<void>((res) => (lockHeld = res));
  const mover = r.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [l] = await tx.periodLocks.hold(org.id, ["org"], "update");
    lockHeld();
    await sleep(300);
    await tx.periodLocks.update(l!.id, { lockedUpTo: at("2026-05-31", "23:59") });
  });
  await holding;
  await rejects(ledger.postVoucher(r, { orgId: org.id, branchId: rpr.id, type: "journal", date: at("2026-05-20"), entries: [{ ledgerId: cash.id, debitPaise: 100, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: capital.id, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 100 }] }), PeriodLockedError, `${tag} concurrent lock change: the in-flight posting waits, then fails`);
  await mover;
  const mayInvoiceVoucher = (await r.vouchers.find({ invoiceId: inv.invoice.id, type: "sales" } as any))[0]!;
  await rejects(ledger.cancelVoucher(r, mayInvoiceVoucher.id), PeriodLockedError, `${tag} cancelling a voucher in the locked period fails`);
  await r.transaction(async (tx) => {
    for (const l of await tx.periodLocks.hold(org.id, ["org"], "update")) await tx.periodLocks.update(l.id, { lockedUpTo: null });
  });
  ok((await ledger.trialBalance(r, { orgId: org.id })).differencePaise === 0, `${tag} books balance at the end`);
  await old.close();
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ engine boundary

/** ledger-kit is a port, not a wrapper: its source must not call db-kit's accounting functions. */
function engineBoundary() {
  console.log("\n[engine boundary]");
  const engine = /\b(postVoucher|cancelVoucher|seedChartOfAccounts|postInvoice|postPayment|unpostInvoice|assertBalanced|assertPeriodOpen|salesEntries|receiptEntries|defaultPostingHook|trialBalance|profitAndLoss|balanceSheet|ledgerStatement|ledgerBalance|dayBook|cashBook|gstSummary|outstandingReceivables|TALLY_GROUPS|DEFAULT_LEDGERS|VOUCHER_PREFIX|voucherCounterKey|UnbalancedVoucherError)\b/;
  const offenders: string[] = [];
  for (const f of readdirSync("src")) {
    const imports = readFileSync(join("src", f), "utf8").match(/import[^;]*from\s+"@mgpl-diagnostics\/db-kit"/g) ?? [];
    if (imports.some((i) => engine.test(i))) offenders.push(f);
  }
  ok(offenders.length === 0, `src/ imports no accounting function from db-kit${offenders.length ? ` (offenders: ${offenders.join(", ")})` : ""}`);
  const exported = Object.keys(ledger);
  const wanted = ["seedChartOfAccounts", "postVoucher", "cancelVoucher", "assertBalanced", "assertPeriodOpen", "postInvoice", "postPayment", "unpostInvoice", "ledgerPostingHook",
    "trialBalance", "ledgerBalance", "ledgerStatement", "cashBook", "dayBook", "profitAndLoss", "balanceSheet", "outstandingReceivables", "gstSummary", "UnbalancedVoucherError"];
  ok(wanted.every((w) => exported.includes(w)), `exports what finance-kit and db-kit need (${wanted.length} names)`);
  ok(ledger.UnbalancedVoucherError.prototype instanceof ValidationError && new ledger.UnbalancedVoucherError(1, 2).statusCode === 422, "UnbalancedVoucherError is a db-kit ValidationError (422)");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ main

async function main() {
  engineBoundary();

  const rs = await MongoMemoryReplSet.create({ replSet: { count: 1, storageEngine: "wiredTiger" } });
  await backendSuite("mongo", (name, posting) => createDb({ backend: "mongo", mongo: { uri: rs.getUri(name) }, posting }));
  await rs.stop();

  const dir = join(tmpdir(), `ledger-kit-pg-${process.pid}`);
  rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  const pg = new EmbeddedPostgres({ databaseDir: dir, user: "postgres", password: "postgres", port: 54333, persistent: false });
  await pg.initialise();
  await pg.start();
  const created = new Set<string>();
  await backendSuite("pg", async (name, posting) => {
    if (!created.has(name)) { await pg.createDatabase(name); created.add(name); }
    return createDb({ backend: "pg", pg: { url: `postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:54333/${name}` }, posting });
  });
  await pg.stop();
  rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });

  console.log(`\n${passed} passed, ${failed} failed in ${((Date.now() - START) / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`);
  process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error(e);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

## File: src/chart.ts

```ts
import type { AccountGroup, AccountNature, Id, Ledger, Repositories } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";

/**
 * Chart of accounts: groups → ledgers.
 *
 * The 28 standard groups (15 primary + 13 sub-groups) and the ledgers a diagnostic lab needs on day
 * one. Names, parents and system keys are the ones db-kit 1.1.0 seeds, so books started with db-kit
 * carry on unchanged under ledger-kit.
 */

export interface GroupDef {
  name: string;
  parent?: string;
  nature?: AccountNature;
  /** Shown above the gross-profit line of the P&L (trading account). */
  gp?: boolean;
}

/** The 28 standard groups: 15 primary + 13 sub-groups. A sub-group takes its parent's nature. */
export const TALLY_GROUPS: GroupDef[] = [
  { name: "Capital Account", nature: "liabilities" },
  { name: "Loans (Liability)", nature: "liabilities" },
  { name: "Current Liabilities", nature: "liabilities" },
  { name: "Fixed Assets", nature: "assets" },
  { name: "Investments", nature: "assets" },
  { name: "Current Assets", nature: "assets" },
  { name: "Branch / Divisions", nature: "liabilities" },
  { name: "Misc. Expenses (ASSET)", nature: "assets" },
  { name: "Suspense A/c", nature: "liabilities" },
  { name: "Sales Accounts", nature: "income", gp: true },
  { name: "Purchase Accounts", nature: "expenses", gp: true },
  { name: "Direct Incomes", nature: "income", gp: true },
  { name: "Indirect Incomes", nature: "income" },
  { name: "Direct Expenses", nature: "expenses", gp: true },
  { name: "Indirect Expenses", nature: "expenses" },
  { name: "Reserves & Surplus", parent: "Capital Account" },
  { name: "Bank OD A/c", parent: "Loans (Liability)" },
  { name: "Secured Loans", parent: "Loans (Liability)" },
  { name: "Unsecured Loans", parent: "Loans (Liability)" },
  { name: "Duties & Taxes", parent: "Current Liabilities" },
  { name: "Provisions", parent: "Current Liabilities" },
  { name: "Sundry Creditors", parent: "Current Liabilities" },
  { name: "Bank Accounts", parent: "Current Assets" },
  { name: "Cash-in-Hand", parent: "Current Assets" },
  { name: "Deposits (Asset)", parent: "Current Assets" },
  { name: "Loans & Advances (Asset)", parent: "Current Assets" },
  { name: "Stock-in-Hand", parent: "Current Assets" },
  { name: "Sundry Debtors", parent: "Current Assets" },
];

/** Ledgers a diagnostic lab needs on day one. `key` = systemKey used by automatic posting. */
export const DEFAULT_LEDGERS: { name: string; group: string; key?: string }[] = [
  { name: "Capital Account", group: "Capital Account", key: "capital" },
  { name: "Cash", group: "Cash-in-Hand", key: "cash" },
  { name: "Bank Account", group: "Bank Accounts", key: "bank" },
  { name: "UPI Collections", group: "Bank Accounts", key: "upi" },
  { name: "Card Settlements", group: "Bank Accounts", key: "card" },
  { name: "Patient Receivables", group: "Sundry Debtors", key: "receivables" },
  { name: "Lab Test Income", group: "Sales Accounts", key: "sales" },
  { name: "Output CGST", group: "Duties & Taxes", key: "cgst" },
  { name: "Output SGST", group: "Duties & Taxes", key: "sgst" },
  { name: "Output IGST", group: "Duties & Taxes", key: "igst" },
  { name: "Discount Allowed", group: "Indirect Expenses", key: "discount" },
  { name: "Round Off", group: "Indirect Expenses", key: "round_off" },
  { name: "Doctor Referral Commission", group: "Indirect Expenses", key: "doctor_commission" },
  { name: "Doctors Payable", group: "Sundry Creditors", key: "doctors_payable" },
  { name: "Reagents & Consumables", group: "Purchase Accounts", key: "purchases" },
  { name: "Salaries", group: "Indirect Expenses" },
  { name: "Rent", group: "Indirect Expenses" },
  { name: "Electricity", group: "Indirect Expenses" },
  { name: "Lab Equipment", group: "Fixed Assets" },
];

/** Creates the groups and default ledgers for an organisation (skips ones that exist). */
export async function seedChartOfAccounts(repos: Repositories, orgId: Id): Promise<{ groups: AccountGroup[]; ledgers: Ledger[] }> {
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const byName = new Map<string, AccountGroup>();
    for (const g of await tx.accountGroups.find({ orgId })) byName.set(g.name, g);
    for (const def of TALLY_GROUPS) {
      if (byName.has(def.name)) continue;
      const parent = def.parent ? byName.get(def.parent)! : null;
      const g = await tx.accountGroups.create({
        orgId, name: def.name, parentId: parent?.id ?? null,
        nature: def.nature ?? parent!.nature, affectsGrossProfit: def.gp ?? parent?.affectsGrossProfit ?? false, system: true,
      });
      byName.set(g.name, g);
    }
    const existing = new Set((await tx.ledgers.find({ orgId })).map((l) => l.name));
    for (const l of DEFAULT_LEDGERS) {
      if (existing.has(l.name)) continue;
      await tx.ledgers.create({ orgId, name: l.name, groupId: byName.get(l.group)!.id, openingPaise: 0, systemKey: l.key ?? null, active: true });
    }
    return { groups: [...byName.values()], ledgers: await tx.ledgers.find({ orgId }) };
  });
}

## File: src/posting.ts

```ts
import { NotFoundError, type Id, type Invoice, type Ledger, type Payment, type PaymentMode, type PostingHook, type Repositories, type Voucher, type VoucherEntry } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { cancelVoucher, postVoucher } from "./vouchers";

/**
 * Automatic posting for db-kit's billing workflows:
 *
 *   Sales voucher (invoice)       Dr Patient Receivables  total
 *                                 Dr Discount Allowed     discount
 *                                 Cr Lab Test Income      gross (qty × rate)
 *                                 Cr Output CGST / SGST   tax  (IGST when the org's settings.interState is set)
 *                                 Dr/Cr Round Off         rounding
 *   Receipt voucher (payment)     Dr Cash / Bank / UPI / Card    Cr Patient Receivables
 *   Payment voucher (refund)      Dr Patient Receivables         Cr Cash / Bank / UPI / Card
 *
 * Without a chart of accounts (no "receivables" and "sales" ledgers) nothing is posted.
 */

/** The system ledger a payment mode lands in. */
export const MODE_LEDGER: Record<PaymentMode, string> = {
  cash: "cash", upi: "upi", wallet: "upi", card: "card", netbanking: "bank", cheque: "bank", insurance: "bank",
};

/** Ledgers by systemKey, or null when the organisation has no chart of accounts (posting is skipped). */
export async function systemLedgers(repos: Repositories, orgId: Id): Promise<Map<string, Ledger> | null> {
  const all = await repos.ledgers.find({ orgId });
  const map = new Map<string, Ledger>();
  for (const l of all) if (l.systemKey) map.set(l.systemKey, l);
  return map.has("receivables") && map.has("sales") ? map : null;
}

const need = (m: Map<string, Ledger>, key: string) => {
  const l = m.get(key);
  if (!l) throw new NotFoundError("Ledger with systemKey", key);
  return l.id;
};

export function salesEntries(invoice: Invoice, ledgers: Map<string, Ledger>, interState = false): VoucherEntry[] {
  const gross = invoice.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.amountPaise + i.discountPaise, 0);
  const tax = invoice.taxPaise;
  const cgst = Math.floor(tax / 2);
  const r = invoice.roundOffPaise;
  const e: VoucherEntry[] = [
    { ledgerId: need(ledgers, "receivables"), debitPaise: invoice.totalPaise, creditPaise: 0, invoiceId: invoice.id },
    { ledgerId: need(ledgers, "discount"), debitPaise: invoice.discountPaise, creditPaise: 0 },
    { ledgerId: need(ledgers, "sales"), debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: gross },
  ];
  if (tax > 0) {
    if (interState) e.push({ ledgerId: need(ledgers, "igst"), debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: tax });
    else e.push({ ledgerId: need(ledgers, "cgst"), debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: cgst }, { ledgerId: need(ledgers, "sgst"), debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: tax - cgst });
  }
  if (r !== 0) e.push({ ledgerId: need(ledgers, "round_off"), debitPaise: r < 0 ? -r : 0, creditPaise: r > 0 ? r : 0 });
  return e.filter((x) => x.debitPaise > 0 || x.creditPaise > 0);
}

export function receiptEntries(payment: Payment, ledgers: Map<string, Ledger>): VoucherEntry[] {
  const money = need(ledgers, MODE_LEDGER[payment.mode]);
  const recv = need(ledgers, "receivables");
  return payment.kind === "refund"
    ? [{ ledgerId: recv, debitPaise: payment.amountPaise, creditPaise: 0, invoiceId: payment.invoiceId }, { ledgerId: money, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: payment.amountPaise }]
    : [{ ledgerId: money, debitPaise: payment.amountPaise, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: recv, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: payment.amountPaise, invoiceId: payment.invoiceId }];
}

/** Posts the sales voucher for an invoice (inside the caller's transaction). No-op without a chart of accounts. */
export async function postInvoice(tx: Repositories, invoice: Invoice, actorId?: Id): Promise<Voucher | null> {
  const ledgers = await systemLedgers(tx, invoice.orgId);
  if (!ledgers) return null;
  const org = await tx.orgs.get(invoice.orgId);
  return postVoucher(tx, {
    orgId: invoice.orgId, branchId: invoice.branchId, type: "sales", date: invoice.issuedAt ?? new Date(),
    narration: `Invoice ${invoice.invoiceNo}`, entries: salesEntries(invoice, ledgers, Boolean(org?.settings?.interState)), invoiceId: invoice.id,
  }, actorId);
}

/** Posts a receipt (payment) or payment (refund) voucher. No-op without a chart of accounts. */
export async function postPayment(tx: Repositories, payment: Payment, invoiceNo: string, actorId?: Id): Promise<Voucher | null> {
  const ledgers = await systemLedgers(tx, payment.orgId);
  if (!ledgers) return null;
  return postVoucher(tx, {
    orgId: payment.orgId, branchId: payment.branchId, type: payment.kind === "refund" ? "payment" : "receipt", date: payment.receivedAt,
    narration: `${payment.kind === "refund" ? "Refund" : "Payment"} ${payment.mode.toUpperCase()} against ${invoiceNo}`,
    entries: receiptEntries(payment, ledgers), invoiceId: payment.invoiceId, paymentId: payment.id,
  }, actorId);
}

/** Cancels the sales voucher of a cancelled invoice. */
export async function unpostInvoice(tx: Repositories, invoiceId: Id, actorId?: Id): Promise<void> {
  for (const v of await tx.vouchers.find({ invoiceId, type: "sales", status: "posted" } as any)) await cancelVoucher(tx, v.id, actorId);
}

/**
 * The posting hook for db-kit's billing: `createDb({ ..., posting: ledgerPostingHook })`. issueInvoice,
 * recordPayment and cancelInvoice then post through ledger-kit, inside their own transaction.
 */
export const ledgerPostingHook: PostingHook = {
  async invoiceIssued(tx, invoice, actorId) {
    await postInvoice(tx, invoice, actorId);
  },
  async paymentRecorded(tx, payment, invoiceNo, actorId) {
    await postPayment(tx, payment, invoiceNo, actorId);
  },
  async invoiceCancelled(tx, invoiceId, actorId) {
    await unpostInvoice(tx, invoiceId, actorId);
  },
};
```

## File: src/reports.ts

```ts
import { NotFoundError, type AccountGroup, type AccountNature, type Id, type Invoice, type Ledger, type Paise, type Repositories, type Voucher, type VoucherType } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";

/**
 * Books reports, computed from postings. Balances are in paise, positive = Debit.
 * All reports accept an optional branchId to see one branch's books.
 */

export interface Scope {
  orgId: Id;
  branchId?: Id;
}

const day = 24 * 3600 * 1000;
const before = (d: Date) => new Date(d.getTime() - 1);

async function chart(repos: Repositories, orgId: Id) {
  const [groups, ledgers] = await Promise.all([repos.accountGroups.find({ orgId }), repos.ledgers.find({ orgId })]);
  const gById = new Map(groups.map((g) => [g.id, g]));
  const primary = (g: AccountGroup): AccountGroup => (g.parentId ? primary(gById.get(g.parentId)!) : g);
  return { groups, ledgers, gById, primary };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ ledgers

export async function ledgerBalance(repos: Repositories, scope: Scope & { ledgerId: Id; asOf?: Date }): Promise<Paise> {
  const ledger = await repos.ledgers.get(scope.ledgerId);
  if (!ledger) throw new NotFoundError("Ledger", scope.ledgerId);
  const [t] = await repos.ledgerEntries.totals({ orgId: scope.orgId, branchId: scope.branchId, ledgerId: scope.ledgerId, to: scope.asOf });
  return (scope.branchId ? 0 : ledger.openingPaise) + (t ? t.debitPaise - t.creditPaise : 0);
}

export interface StatementRow {
  date: Date;
  voucherNo: string;
  voucherType: VoucherType;
  debitPaise: Paise;
  creditPaise: Paise;
  /** Running balance after this row (positive = Dr). */
  balancePaise: Paise;
  invoiceId?: Id | null;
}

/** Ledger account / cash book / bank book: opening, every posting with running balance, closing. */
export async function ledgerStatement(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { ledgerId: Id; from: Date; to: Date }) {
  const ledger = await repos.ledgers.get(q.ledgerId);
  if (!ledger) throw new NotFoundError("Ledger", q.ledgerId);
  const opening = await ledgerBalance(repos, { ...q, asOf: before(q.from) });
  const entries = await repos.ledgerEntries.list({ orgId: q.orgId, branchId: q.branchId, ledgerId: q.ledgerId, from: q.from, to: q.to });
  let bal = opening;
  let dr = 0;
  let cr = 0;
  const rows: StatementRow[] = entries.map((e) => {
    bal += e.debitPaise - e.creditPaise;
    dr += e.debitPaise;
    cr += e.creditPaise;
    return { date: e.date, voucherNo: e.voucherNo, voucherType: e.voucherType, debitPaise: e.debitPaise, creditPaise: e.creditPaise, balancePaise: bal, invoiceId: e.invoiceId };
  });
  return { ledger, openingPaise: opening, rows, totalDebitPaise: dr, totalCreditPaise: cr, closingPaise: bal };
}

/** Cash book = the statement of the "cash" system ledger. */
export async function cashBook(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { from: Date; to: Date }) {
  const cash = await repos.ledgers.findBySystemKey(q.orgId, "cash");
  if (!cash) throw new NotFoundError("Ledger with systemKey", "cash");
  return ledgerStatement(repos, { ...q, ledgerId: cash.id });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ trial balance

export interface TrialBalanceRow {
  ledger: Ledger;
  group: AccountGroup;
  primaryGroup: AccountGroup;
  debitPaise: Paise;
  creditPaise: Paise;
}

/** Closing balance of every ledger, on its debit or credit side. Debits = credits when the books are right. */
export async function trialBalance(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { asOf?: Date }) {
  const { ledgers, gById, primary } = await chart(repos, q.orgId);
  const totals = new Map((await repos.ledgerEntries.totals({ orgId: q.orgId, branchId: q.branchId, to: q.asOf })).map((t) => [t.ledgerId, t]));
  const rows: TrialBalanceRow[] = [];
  let dr = 0;
  let cr = 0;
  for (const l of ledgers) {
    const t = totals.get(l.id);
    const bal = (q.branchId ? 0 : l.openingPaise) + (t ? t.debitPaise - t.creditPaise : 0);
    if (bal === 0) continue;
    const group = gById.get(l.groupId)!;
    rows.push({ ledger: l, group, primaryGroup: primary(group), debitPaise: bal > 0 ? bal : 0, creditPaise: bal < 0 ? -bal : 0 });
    if (bal > 0) dr += bal;
    else cr -= bal;
  }
  rows.sort((a, b) => a.primaryGroup.name.localeCompare(b.primaryGroup.name) || a.ledger.name.localeCompare(b.ledger.name));
  /** Non-zero only when opening balances were entered unbalanced (Tally shows "Difference in opening balances"). */
  return { rows, totalDebitPaise: dr, totalCreditPaise: cr, differencePaise: dr - cr };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ P&L and balance sheet

export interface GroupLine {
  group: AccountGroup;
  amountPaise: Paise;
  ledgers: { ledger: Ledger; amountPaise: Paise }[];
}

/** Income and expenses for a period, by primary group; gross and net profit. Year-end closing vouchers are left out. */
export async function profitAndLoss(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { from: Date; to: Date }) {
  const { ledgers, gById, primary } = await chart(repos, q.orgId);
  const totals = new Map((await repos.ledgerEntries.totals({ orgId: q.orgId, branchId: q.branchId, from: q.from, to: q.to, excludeVoucherTypes: ["closing"] })).map((t) => [t.ledgerId, t]));
  const lines = new Map<Id, GroupLine>();
  for (const l of ledgers) {
    const p = primary(gById.get(l.groupId)!);
    if (p.nature !== "income" && p.nature !== "expenses") continue;
    const t = totals.get(l.id);
    if (!t) continue;
    // income is a credit balance, expense a debit balance: show both as positive amounts
    const amount = p.nature === "income" ? t.creditPaise - t.debitPaise : t.debitPaise - t.creditPaise;
    if (amount === 0) continue;
    const line = lines.get(p.id) ?? { group: p, amountPaise: 0, ledgers: [] };
    line.amountPaise += amount;
    line.ledgers.push({ ledger: l, amountPaise: amount });
    lines.set(p.id, line);
  }
  const all = [...lines.values()];
  const sum = (nature: AccountNature, gp: boolean) => all.filter((x) => x.group.nature === nature && x.group.affectsGrossProfit === gp).reduce((s, x) => s + x.amountPaise, 0);
  const grossProfit = sum("income", true) - sum("expenses", true);
  const netProfit = grossProfit + sum("income", false) - sum("expenses", false);
  return {
    income: all.filter((x) => x.group.nature === "income"),
    expenses: all.filter((x) => x.group.nature === "expenses"),
    grossProfitPaise: grossProfit,
    netProfitPaise: netProfit,
  };
}

/** Assets and liabilities at a date; profit to date is shown on the liabilities side, like Tally. */
export async function balanceSheet(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { asOf: Date }) {
  const { ledgers, gById, primary } = await chart(repos, q.orgId);
  const totals = new Map((await repos.ledgerEntries.totals({ orgId: q.orgId, branchId: q.branchId, to: q.asOf })).map((t) => [t.ledgerId, t]));
  const lines = new Map<Id, GroupLine>();
  let profit = 0;
  for (const l of ledgers) {
    const p = primary(gById.get(l.groupId)!);
    const t = totals.get(l.id);
    const bal = (q.branchId ? 0 : l.openingPaise) + (t ? t.debitPaise - t.creditPaise : 0); // +Dr
    if (bal === 0) continue;
    if (p.nature === "income" || p.nature === "expenses") {
      profit -= bal; // income credit (−) raises profit, expense debit (+) lowers it
      continue;
    }
    const amount = p.nature === "assets" ? bal : -bal;
    const line = lines.get(p.id) ?? { group: p, amountPaise: 0, ledgers: [] };
    line.amountPaise += amount;
    line.ledgers.push({ ledger: l, amountPaise: amount });
    lines.set(p.id, line);
  }
  const all = [...lines.values()];
  const assets = all.filter((x) => x.group.nature === "assets");
  const liabilities = all.filter((x) => x.group.nature === "liabilities");
  const totalAssets = assets.reduce((s, x) => s + x.amountPaise, 0);
  const totalLiabilities = liabilities.reduce((s, x) => s + x.amountPaise, 0) + profit;
  return { assets, liabilities, profitPaise: profit, totalAssetsPaise: totalAssets, totalLiabilitiesPaise: totalLiabilities, differencePaise: totalAssets - totalLiabilities };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ day book, outstanding, GST

export async function dayBook(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { from: Date; to: Date; type?: VoucherType }): Promise<Voucher[]> {
  return repos.vouchers.listByDate({ orgId: q.orgId, branchId: q.branchId, from: q.from, to: q.to, type: q.type, includeCancelled: true });
}

export interface OutstandingRow {
  invoice: Invoice;
  ageDays: number;
  bucket: "0-30" | "31-60" | "61-90" | "90+";
}

/** Bills receivable with ageing buckets (Tally "Bills Receivable"). */
export async function outstandingReceivables(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { asOf?: Date }) {
  const asOf = q.asOf ?? new Date();
  const invoices = await repos.invoices.listOutstanding(q.orgId, q.branchId);
  const rows: OutstandingRow[] = invoices.map((invoice) => {
    const ageDays = Math.max(0, Math.floor((asOf.getTime() - (invoice.issuedAt ?? invoice.createdAt).getTime()) / day));
    const bucket = ageDays <= 30 ? "0-30" : ageDays <= 60 ? "31-60" : ageDays <= 90 ? "61-90" : "90+";
    return { invoice, ageDays, bucket };
  });
  const buckets = { "0-30": 0, "31-60": 0, "61-90": 0, "90+": 0 } as Record<OutstandingRow["bucket"], Paise>;
  for (const r of rows) buckets[r.bucket] += r.invoice.duePaise;
  return { rows, buckets, totalDuePaise: rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.invoice.duePaise, 0) };
}

/** Output tax for a period from the GST ledgers, with the taxable value from sales. */
export async function gstSummary(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { from: Date; to: Date }) {
  const keyed = new Map<string, Ledger>();
  for (const l of await repos.ledgers.find({ orgId: q.orgId })) if (l.systemKey) keyed.set(l.systemKey, l);
  const totals = new Map((await repos.ledgerEntries.totals({ orgId: q.orgId, branchId: q.branchId, from: q.from, to: q.to, excludeVoucherTypes: ["closing"] })).map((t) => [t.ledgerId, t]));
  const credit = (key: string) => {
    const l = keyed.get(key);
    const t = l && totals.get(l.id);
    return t ? t.creditPaise - t.debitPaise : 0;
  };
  const cgst = credit("cgst"), sgst = credit("sgst"), igst = credit("igst");
  // taxable value = sales (gross) less discounts allowed
  return { taxableValuePaise: credit("sales") + credit("discount"), cgstPaise: cgst, sgstPaise: sgst, igstPaise: igst, totalTaxPaise: cgst + sgst + igst };
}
```


---

## File: src/vouchers.ts

```ts
import {
  financialYear, NotFoundError, PeriodLockedError, ValidationError, type Id, type Repositories, type Voucher, type VoucherEntry, type VoucherType,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";

/**
 * Vouchers: numbered per type per financial year, balanced, stored with one LedgerEntry per line,
 * refused in a locked period. Voucher numbers and counter keys are the ones db-kit 1.1.0 uses, so a
 * series started there continues here without a gap or a repeat.
 */

export const VOUCHER_PREFIX: Record<VoucherType, string> = {
  sales: "SAL", receipt: "RCT", payment: "PMT", journal: "JRN", contra: "CTR", credit_note: "CRN", debit_note: "DBN", purchase: "PUR", closing: "CLS",
};

export const voucherCounterKey = (orgId: Id, type: VoucherType, fy: string) => `voucher:${orgId}:${type}:${fy}`;

export interface VoucherInput {
  orgId: Id;
  branchId: Id;
  type: VoucherType;
  date?: Date;
  narration?: string;
  entries: VoucherEntry[];
  invoiceId?: Id | null;
  paymentId?: Id | null;
}

export class UnbalancedVoucherError extends ValidationError {
  readonly statusCode = 422;
  constructor(debit: number, credit: number) {
    super(`Voucher does not balance: debit ${debit} ≠ credit ${credit} paise`);
    this.name = "UnbalancedVoucherError";
  }
}

/** Throws unless every line is one-sided whole paise and debits equal credits. */
export function assertBalanced(entries: VoucherEntry[]): void {
  if (entries.length < 2) throw new UnbalancedVoucherError(0, 0);
  let dr = 0;
  let cr = 0;
  for (const e of entries) {
    const okDr = Number.isInteger(e.debitPaise) && e.debitPaise >= 0;
    const okCr = Number.isInteger(e.creditPaise) && e.creditPaise >= 0;
    if (!okDr || !okCr || (e.debitPaise > 0) === (e.creditPaise > 0)) throw new ValidationError("Each voucher line needs exactly one positive debit or credit (whole paise)");
    dr += e.debitPaise;
    cr += e.creditPaise;
  }
  if (dr !== cr) throw new UnbalancedVoucherError(dr, cr);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ lock dates

/**
 * Inside a transaction: throws PeriodLockedError when `date` is on or before the organisation's or
 * the branch's lock date. Holds both lock rows until commit, so a concurrent lock change cannot slip
 * in between this check and the commit. postVoucher and cancelVoucher call it.
 */
export async function assertPeriodOpen(tx: Repositories, orgId: Id, branchId: Id, date: Date): Promise<void> {
  for (const lock of await tx.periodLocks.hold(orgId, ["org", branchId], "share"))
    if (lock.lockedUpTo && date.getTime() <= lock.lockedUpTo.getTime()) throw new PeriodLockedError(date, lock.lockedUpTo, lock.scope);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ post and cancel

/** Numbers, stores and posts a voucher atomically (voucher + its ledger entries). Refused in a locked period. */
export async function postVoucher(repos: Repositories, input: VoucherInput, actorId?: Id): Promise<Voucher> {
  const entries = input.entries.filter((e) => e.debitPaise > 0 || e.creditPaise > 0);
  assertBalanced(entries);
  const date = input.date ?? new Date();
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await assertPeriodOpen(tx, input.orgId, input.branchId, date);
    const ids = [...new Set(entries.map((e) => e.ledgerId))];
    for (const id of ids) if (!(await tx.ledgers.get(id))) throw new NotFoundError("Ledger", id);
    const fy = financialYear(date);
    const seq = await tx.counters.next(voucherCounterKey(input.orgId, input.type, fy));
    const voucher = await tx.vouchers.create({
      orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, type: input.type, voucherNo: `${VOUCHER_PREFIX[input.type]}/${fy}/${String(seq).padStart(6, "0")}`,
      date, narration: input.narration, entries, invoiceId: input.invoiceId ?? null, paymentId: input.paymentId ?? null, status: "posted", createdBy: actorId ?? null,
    });
    await tx.ledgerEntries.insertMany(entries.map((e) => ({
      orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, voucherId: voucher.id, voucherType: input.type, voucherNo: voucher.voucherNo,
      ledgerId: e.ledgerId, date, debitPaise: e.debitPaise, creditPaise: e.creditPaise, invoiceId: e.invoiceId ?? null,
    })));
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: `voucher.${input.type}`, entity: "voucher", entityId: voucher.id, data: { voucherNo: voucher.voucherNo } });
    return voucher;
  });
}

/** Cancels a voucher: the number stays, the postings are removed. Refused in a locked period. */
export async function cancelVoucher(repos: Repositories, voucherId: Id, actorId?: Id): Promise<Voucher> {
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const v = await tx.vouchers.get(voucherId);
    if (!v) throw new NotFoundError("Voucher", voucherId);
    if (v.status === "cancelled") return v;
    await assertPeriodOpen(tx, v.orgId, v.branchId, v.date);
    await tx.ledgerEntries.deleteByVoucher(voucherId);
    const out = (await tx.vouchers.update(voucherId, { status: "cancelled" }))!;
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: v.orgId, branchId: v.branchId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "voucher.cancel", entity: "voucher", entityId: voucherId });
    return out;
  });
}
```
